title: A Shared Horizon
intro: A lone light can mark a channel. A network can reveal the whole coast. Small skiffs and prism beds still shape the work of the largest observatories.
completion: The harbor recognizes a pattern: old craft and new instruments belong to the same sky.
hints: Reach 25 Charts to reveal cross-tier links.
Build 25 Skiffs and 25 Nurseries in the same fleet.
